note: Verdicts from the owner's own runs of `npm run backtest`, `npm run forecast:evaluate` and `npm run signals:evaluate` (all three run by `npm run mac:validate`), copied here so the methods note (docs/METHODS.md) can state them. `kind` says which folder of docs/validation/ holds the test (backtest: preregistered/, the default; forecast: forecasts/; signal: signals/). The live verdicts are in data/local/validation/ on the computer that ran them (Menu > Models & validation), and they win over this file. Add a row only from a real run, with npm run track-record:import (it reads data/local/validation/ and never changes a row already on record, except to add the p of a run on the same test file with the same verdict to a passed or failed row recorded before rows carried p); never edit a figure by hand. `forward` summarises the forward record (data/local/validation/forward.jsonl) from the same import.
